facts.statement: The Group is engaged in the business of manufacturing, selling and distribution of paints, coatings, products related to home décor, bath fittings, modular kitchen and accessories, decorative lighting, uPVC doors and windows and providing related services.
facts.quote: The Group is engaged in the business of manufacturing, selling and distribution of paints, coatings, products related to home décor, bath fittings, modular kitchen & accessories, decorative lighting, uPVC doors & windows and providing related services.

facts.statement: The liquidity position of the Company was Rs 9,014.60 crores as at 31st March 2026 compared to Rs 4,533.55 crores in the previous year.
facts.quote: The Company believes that its liquidity position (₹ 9,014.60 crores as at 31st March 2026 (Previous Year-  ₹ 4,533.55 crores)), anticipated future internally generated funds from operations, and its fully available revolving undrawn credit facility will enable it to meet its future known obligations in the ordinary course of business.
